source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the model paper (PDF 143-145, printed 139-141) solved: MCQs keyed from the chapters' text, short and long questions with simple glossed answers and 'Wazahat' boxes; the misprint in MCQ 9 is corrected.

blocks.text: Yeh kitab ke aakhir mein chhapa Class 12 Computer Science and Entrepreneurship ka model paper hai (printed page 139-141), hal ke saath. Objective hisse mein 15 MCQs hain (15 marks, 20 minute) aur subjective hisse mein Section I ke teen sawal (har aik mein 9 short sawal, koi 6 karne hain) aur Section II ke 5 long sawal (koi 3 karne hain); subjective 60 marks, 2:10 ghante. Model paper koi answer key nahi deta; MCQs ke jawab kitab ke chapters ke text se hain. Short sawalon ke jawab chhote (2 marks wale) aur long sawalon ke poore (8 marks wale) hain. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.
Model Paper Computer Science and Entrepreneurship Intermediate part-II
OBJECTIVE
Question 1: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)

Hidayat: sahi jawab ke gird daira lagayein. Har sawal ke chaar mumkin jawab A, B, C, D diye gaye hain. Jo jawab aap ke khayal mein sahi hai, answer book mein us sawal ke saamne wala daira marker ya pen ki siyahi se bharein. Kaat-chhaant (cutting) ya do ya zyada daire bharne par us sawal ka zero mark milega.

Kul marks: 15
Waqt: 20 minute

blocks.prompt:
1. Which protocol is mainly used to view web pages?
(Web pages dekhne ke liye zyada tar kaunsa protocol use hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) web browser aur web server ke darmiyan web pages bhejta hai (1.7).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which device converts digital signals for internet transmission?
(Internet par bhejne ke liye digital signals ko kaunsa device badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Modem digital data ko transmission ke qabil signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital mein badalta hai (1.4).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of the following is a compound proposition?
(In mein se compound proposition kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: P∧Q (P AND Q) do simple propositions ko AND se jorta hai, is liye compound hai; akela P ya Q simple proposition hai (2.4).

blocks.prompt:
4. A proposition that is true for at least one case is called:
(Jo proposition kam az kam aik surat mein sach ho, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar kam az kam aik combination proposition ko true kar de to woh satisfiable hai (2.7).

blocks.prompt:
5. Which concept hides data inside a class?
(Kaunsa concept data ko class ke andar chhupata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Encapsulation data aur methods ko class mein band karti aur data tak seedhi pohanch rokti hai (3.2).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which keyword is used to define a class in Python?
(Python mein class banane ke liye kaunsa keyword use hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Class keyword class se banti hai, maslan class Student: ; def function ya method banata hai (3.2).

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following is Python's built-in GUI toolkit?
(In mein se Python ka built-in GUI toolkit kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tkinter Python ka standard GUI toolkit hai jo Python ke saath pehle se install hota hai (4.1).

blocks.prompt:
8. What widget is used to get user input in Tkinter?
(Tkinter mein user se input lene ke liye kaunsa widget use hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Entry field naam ya password jaisa text likhne ke liye hai; us ki value get() se parhi jati hai (4.1).

blocks.prompt:
9. Which ython module is used for unit testing?
(Unit testing ke liye Python ka kaunsa module use hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: unittest Python ka built-in module hai jo test cases banata aur chalata hai (Unit Testing). numpy aur matplotlib data aur graphs ki libraries hain, aur os operating system ke kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Model paper mein sawal 9 "ython" aur option (c) "unitest" chhapa hai. Sahi alfaaz "Python" aur "unittest" hain (do t), jaisa chapter 5 (Unit Testing) mein hai. Sahi jawab (c) unittest.

blocks.prompt:
10. Which Python keyword is used for exception handling?
(Exception handling ke liye Python ka kaunsa keyword use hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python exceptions try-except se pakarta hai; try-catch Java aur C++ jaisi languages mein hai, Python mein nahi (Exception Handling).

blocks.prompt:
11. Which metric measures overall correctness of a model?
(Model ki majmui durusti (overall correctness) kaunsa metric napta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Accuracy (6.7) batati hai ke kul predictions mein se kitni sahi hain: (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN).

blocks.prompt:
12. Machine learning allows systems to:
(Machine learning systems ko kya karne deti hai?)

options.text: Data se seekhna aur performance behtar karna

blocks.explanation: Machine learning (6.3) mein system explicit programming (har qaida likhne) ke baghair tajurbe se behtar hota hai: data se patterns seekhta hai aur zyada data se zyada durust hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
13. Which of the following is a test statistic?
(In mein se test statistic kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Test statistics (7.3) sample data se nikali values hain jin se nataij ka muqabla hota hai; kitab ki misalein t-value aur chi-square value hain. Mean, mode, median sirf ausat hain.

blocks.prompt:
14. Which of the following is an example of Cloud Computing?
(In mein se Cloud Computing ki misal kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amazon Web Services (AWS) internet ke zariye web hosting, data storage aur application development ki cloud services deti hai (8.1, Examples: AWS, Microsoft Azure). MS-Word computer par hi chalta hai, USB drive local storage hai aur smartwatch IoT device hai.

blocks.prompt:
15. What is the main danger of downloading unknown software?
(Na-maloom software download karne ka sab se bara khatra kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Na-maloom websites ke downloads mein virus ya spyware chhupe ho sakte hain jo computer ko nuqsan aur be-ijazat data chori karte hain (9.1).

blocks.text: SUBJECTIVE

Kul marks: 60
Waqt: 2 ghante 10 minute (2:10 hours)
SECTION I
Q # 2: Write short answers of any six questions from the following: (6*2=12)
(Neeche diye sawalon mein se koi chhe ke mukhtasar jawab likhein. Har jawab 2 marks: 6 × 2 = 12. Yeh sawal chapter 1, 2 aur 6 se hain.)

blocks.prompt:
i. What is network architecture?
(Network architecture kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network architecture computer network ka mukammal design (naqsha) hai. Yeh batata hai ke computers, servers aur devices kaise rakhe gaye hain aur data kaise bheja jata hai. Is mein hardware, software aur communication rules shamil hain.

blocks.prompt:
ii. A network architecture experiences a single cable break, and the entire network goes down. Which topology is being used, and why did this failure happen?
(Aik cable tootne se poora network band ho gaya. Kaunsi topology use ho rahi hai aur yeh kharabi kyun hui?)
blocks.explanation: Bus topology. Bus topology mein tamam devices aik hi main cable se jure hote hain aur data isi cable par chal kar har device tak pohanchta hai. Koi doosra rasta nahi hota, is liye main cable toot jaye to data devices tak nahi pohanchta aur poora network band ho jata hai (Figure 1.8).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bus topology ko aik gali samjhein jis mein sab ghar hain: gali beech se band ho jaye to koi kahin nahi ja sakta. Is ko "single point of failure" (aik jagah ki kharabi se sab ruk jana) kehte hain. Mesh topology mein bohat se raste hote hain, is liye woh zyada bharosemand hai.

blocks.prompt:
iii. How does DNS (Domain Name System) function like a phonebook for the internet?
(DNS internet ki phonebook ki tarah kaise kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phonebook kisi ka naam dekh kar us ka phone number batati hai; DNS website ka naam dekh kar us ka IP address batata hai. User aasan naam likhta hai jaise www.example.com, aur DNS servers woh number dhoond kar dete hain jo computer use karte hain (jaise 93.184.216.34). Is liye users ko number yaad nahi rakhne parte (1.7, Figure 1.14).

blocks.prompt:
iv. Why is propositional logic insufficient for a statement like "All students love coding," making predicate logic necessary instead?
("All students love coding" jaise jumle ke liye propositional logic kaafi kyun nahi aur predicate logic kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Propositional logic poore jumle ko aik hi sach/jhoot proposition (maslan P) maanti hai; woh is ke andar nahi dekh sakti, har student ki khoobi (property) nahi bata sakti aur "sab" (all) nahi keh sakti. Predicate logic variable, predicates aur universal quantifier ∀ (sab ke liye) use karti hai:
∀x (Student(x) → LovesCoding(x))
yani: har x ke liye, agar x student hai to x ko coding pasand hai (2.8, 2.9).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki misal yaad karein: propositional logic mein A = "Ali is Tall" sirf aik dabba hai, andar nahi dikhta. Predicate logic mein Tall(Ali) likhte hain: subject (Ali) aur property (Tall) dono nazar aate hain. Isi tarah Student(x) aur LovesCoding(x) har student par lagte hain.

blocks.prompt:
v. What it means when a compound statement is called a tautology?
(Jab compound statement ko tautology kaha jaye to is ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Compound statement tautology tab hoti hai jab us ke hisson ki har mumkin truth value par woh sach (true) rahe: us ki truth table ki har row mein T aaye. Misal: P OR NOT P (P ∨ ¬P) hamesha sach hai, P sach ho ya jhoot. Is ka ulat, jo hamesha jhoot ho jaise P AND NOT P, unsatisfiable kehlata hai (2.7).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Truth table se dekhein: P = T ho to NOT P = F, aur T OR F = T. P = F ho to NOT P = T, aur F OR T = T. Dono rows mein T, is liye P OR NOT P tautology hai. Kitab "tautology" lafz use nahi karti; yeh satisfiable (kam az kam aik T) ka sab se mazboot darja hai: har row T.

blocks.prompt:
vi. Formulate a predicate logic statement using variables, a predicate, and a quantifier to represent the sentence: "Someone in this classroom owns a laptop."
(Variables, predicate aur quantifier use kar ke is jumle ka predicate logic statement likhein: "Someone in this classroom owns a laptop.")
blocks.explanation:
∃x (InClassroom(x) ∧ OwnsLaptop(x))
Variable: x, koi shakhs. Predicates: InClassroom(x), OwnsLaptop(x). Quantifier: ∃, existential quantifier (kam az kam aik), kyunke "someone" ka matlab hai koi aik, sab nahi. Parhein: kam az kam aik x aisa hai jo is classroom mein hai aur jis ke paas laptop hai (2.9).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Farq yaad rakhein: "sab" (all, every) ke liye ∀, aur "koi" (someone, at least one) ke liye ∃. ∃ ke saath ∧ (AND) lagta hai, kyunke hum keh rahe hain ke aik hi shakhs mein dono baatein sach hain.

blocks.prompt:
vii. Break down the task of "cleaning a messy bedroom" into three smaller, manageable sub-tasks (Decomposition).
("Bikhre hue kamre ki safai" ko teen chhote, aasan kaamon mein todein (Decomposition).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Kapre utha kar almari ya dhulai wali tokri mein rakhein.
2. Kitabein, basta aur baqi cheezein shelf aur mez par tarteeb se rakhein.
3. Bistar theek karein, farsh par jharoo dein aur kachra bahar phenkein.
Har chhota hissa aasan hai aur aik waqt mein aik kaam hota hai; isi ko decomposition (masle ko hisson mein todna) kehte hain (2.2).

blocks.prompt:
viii. What is the primary difference between Supervised Learning and Unsupervised Learning?
(Supervised Learning aur Unsupervised Learning mein bunyadi farq kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Supervised learning labelled data (har input ke saath sahi jawab) se seekhti hai; unsupervised learning bina label ke data mein khud patterns dhoondti hai (6.3).

rows: Labelled data: har input ke saath sahi jawab
Unlabelled data: sahi jawab nahi diya jata
Apna jawab sahi jawab se mila kar seekhti hai
Data ki mushabahat (similarity) se khud patterns dhoondti hai
Prediction (andaza) ke liye
Milte julte data ke groups (clusters) banati hai
Misal: spam email pehchanna, exam result ka andaza
Misal: customers ke groups, data clustering

blocks.prompt:
ix. Why do we split our data into a training set and a testing set instead of using all of it for training?
(Hum data ko training set aur testing set mein kyun baant'te hain, sara training mein kyun nahi lagate?)
blocks.explanation: Training data model ko patterns sikhata hai; testing data, jo model ne pehle nahi dekha, us ki asal karkardagi (performance) check karta hai. Agar sara data training mein laga dein to model sirf ratta laga sakta hai (overfitting) aur pata nahi chalta ke naye data par kaisa chalega. Aam taqseem 80% training aur 20% testing hai (6.5).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Imtihan ki misal: agar teacher wahi sawal paper mein de jo class mein hal karwaye the, to student ne samjha ya ratta lagaya, pata nahi chalta. Naye sawal (testing data) se asal samajh nazar aati hai.
Q # 3: Write short answers of any six questions from the following: (6*2=12)
(Koi chhe ke mukhtasar jawab; chapter 3, 4 aur 5 se.)

blocks.prompt:
i. How does encapsulation help in keeping data secure and private?
(Encapsulation data ko mehfooz aur private rakhne mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data private bana diya jata hai (self.__balance) taake bahar se seedha na badla ja sake; Python ki name mangling ittefaqi pohanch rokti hai. Data sirf methods jaise deposit(), withdraw() aur get_balance() se parha ya badla jata hai, jo pehle values check kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
ii. If you have a class called Player for a video game, write a single line of code to add an attribute for the player's health and set it to 100.
(Video game ki class Player mein player ki health ka attribute bana kar us ki value 100 rakhne ki aik line likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
self.health = 100
Yeh line class ke __init__ method ke andar likhi jati hai; self maujooda Player object hai, is liye har naya player 100 health se shuru hota hai. python -I se check kiya: p = Player(); print(p.health) se 100 print hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text:
Poora chhota program:
class Player:
    def __init__(self):
        self.health = 100

p = Player()
print(p.health)
Output: 100. Agar object pehle se bana ho to bahar se p.health = 100 bhi likh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
iii. You want to clear a text box after a user clicks "Submit". Which Tkinter method helps you delete the text inside an Entry widget?
(User ke "Submit" dabane ke baad text box khali karna hai. Entry widget ka text mitane ke liye Tkinter ka kaunsa method hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Entry widget ka delete() method:
entry.delete(0, tk.END)
Yeh index 0 (pehle character) se END (aakhri character) tak sara text mita deta hai. Isay Submit button ke function mein likhte hain, jab text entry.get() se parh liya jaye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tarteeb yaad rakhein: pehle get() se text lein (warna woh mit jayega), phir delete(0, tk.END) se box khali karein. Kitab Entry aur get() sikhati hai; delete() method kitab mein nahi likha, yeh Tkinter ka apna method hai.

blocks.prompt:
iv. What is the purpose of the .mainloop() function in a Tkinter program?
(Tkinter program mein .mainloop() function ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: mainloop() GUI ko chalata hai: window khuli rakhta hai aur musalsal user ke events (button click, key dabana) ka intezar karta hai aur jure hue functions chalata hai (event-driven programming). Is ke baghair window foran band ho jaye; yeh aakhri line hoti hai, jaise window.mainloop() (4.1).

blocks.prompt:
v. Write a single line of Tkinter code to create a window named root.
(root naam ki window banane ki Tkinter ki aik line likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
root = tk.Tk()
Tk() main window banata hai aur root naam us window ko point karta hai (pehle import tkinter as tk likha ho).

blocks.prompt:
vi. When a user clicks a "Save" button, your program crashes with an error saying the database table does not exist. Analyze the problem: what step did the programmer forget to do first?
("Save" button dabane par program crash ho jata hai aur error kehta hai ke database table maujood nahi. Programmer pehle kaunsa qadam bhool gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Programmer table banana bhool gaya. Data dalne (INSERT) se pehle SQL command CREATE TABLE (jaise CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (...)) cursor.execute() se chala kar table banana aur commit() se save karna zaroori hai. Save button ka INSERT aisi table par chala jo thi hi nahi, is liye SQLite ne error diya (sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table) (4.2).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Almari ki misal: kapre rakhne (INSERT) se pehle almari (TABLE) honi chahiye. Kitab ke sqlite3 program mein yahi tarteeb hai: connect(), cursor(), CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, phir INSERT, phir commit().

blocks.prompt:
vii. In debugging, what is a breakpoint?
(Debugging mein breakpoint kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Breakpoint aik nishan hai jo code ki chuni hui line par lagaya jata hai (PyCharm ya VS Code mein line ke saath click kar ke). Program us line par pohanch kar ruk jata hai. Phir programmer variables ki values aur program ki halat dekhta hai aur step by step chala kar ghalti dhoondta hai (5.2).

blocks.prompt:
viii. Explain the difference between a Syntax Error (like a typo in code) and an Exception.
(Syntax Error (jaise code mein typo) aur Exception ka farq bataiye.)
blocks.explanation: Syntax error Python ke qawaid todta hai aur program chalne se pehle hi ruk jata hai; exception sahi likhe program ke chalte waqt aata hai aur try-except se sambhala ja sakta hai (5.1, Exception Handling).

rows: Code zaban ke qawaid par poora nahi
Code durust hai magar chalte waqt masla aata hai
Program chalne se pehle pakra jata hai; kuch nahi chalta
Chalte waqt ghalat line par aata hai
Sirf code theek kar ke door hota hai
try-except se pakra aur sambhala ja sakta hai
Misal: if x > 5 (colon nahi) se SyntaxError: invalid syntax
Misal: a = 10, b = 0, a / b se ZeroDivisionError

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.1 mein runtime error ko alag likha hai; exception isi runtime error ki qisam hai jise Python "raise" karta hai aur hum try-except se pakar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
ix. Look at this code: result = 10 / user_input. If the user types 0, what specific type of built-in Python exception will be raised?
(Is code ko dekhein: result = 10 / user_input. Agar user 0 likhe to kaunsi built-in Python exception aayegi?)
blocks.explanation: ZeroDivisionError (message: division by zero). Kisi number ko zero se taqseem nahi kar sakte, is liye Python chalte waqt yeh exception deta hai; isay except ZeroDivisionError se sambhal sakte hain. Shart yeh hai ke input number mein badla gaya ho, jaise user_input = int(input()) (5.1, Figure 5.1).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: python -I se check kiya: user_input = 0 par 10 / user_input se ZeroDivisionError: division by zero aata hai. Agar input() ka text "0" seedha use ho (int() ke baghair) to pehle TypeError aata hai, kyunke number ko text se taqseem nahi kar sakte.
Q # 4: Write short answers of any six questions from the following: (6*2=12)
(Koi chhe ke mukhtasar jawab; chapter 7, 8 aur 9 se.)

blocks.prompt:
i. What is the main difference between the Null Hypothesis (H₀) and the Alternative Hypothesis (Hₐ)?
(Null Hypothesis (H₀) aur Alternative Hypothesis (Hₐ) mein bunyadi farq kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahi; alternative hypothesis kehta hai ke asar ya farq hai (7.2).

rows: Koi asar ya farq nahi
Asar ya farq hai
Pehle se maana hua mafrooza; data isi ke khilaf test hota hai
H₀ ka ulat; research aksar isay sabit karna chahti hai
Sirf mazboot saboot par radd hota hai
Sirf mazboot saboot par qubool hota hai
Misal: parhai ka waqt exam marks par asar nahi karta
Misal: parhai ka waqt exam marks par asar karta hai

blocks.prompt:
ii. Why is it considered an ethical issue to completely delete "outliers" (unusual data points) from your dataset just to make your hypothesis look correct?
(Sirf apna hypothesis sahi dikhane ke liye "outliers" (ghair-mamooli data points) poori tarah mita dena akhlaqi masla kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh data ke saath be-imaani hai: data sach nahi dikhata, is liye nateeja janibdar (biased) aur gumrah-kun hota hai. Sirf apne khayal ke haq wala data rakhna confirmation bias hai, aur is par kiye faisle na-munsifana ya nuqsan-deh ho sakte hain. Akhlaqi data use mein imandari aur shaffafiyat (transparency) zaroori hai; outlier sirf tab hataein jab woh waqai ghalti ho, aur batayein ke hataya (7.4, 7.6).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: dawa ke test mein jin 2 mareezon ki halat bigri un ko "outlier" keh kar mita diya jaye to dawa behtar dikhegi, magar asal mareez khatre mein par sakte hain. Kitab ki Figure 7.2 outliers ko dikhati hai taake un ko dekha aur samjha jaye, chhupaya na jaye.

blocks.prompt:
iii. If you reject the Null Hypothesis at a 5% significance level (α= 0.05), what is the percentage chance that you might be making a mistake and rejecting a true hypothesis?
(Agar 5% significance level (α = 0.05) par Null Hypothesis radd karein, to sach hypothesis ko ghalti se radd karne ka kitna fisad chance hai?)
blocks.explanation: 5%. Significance level α woh ghalti ka khatra hai jo hum qubool karte hain: α = 0.05 ka matlab hai 100 mein se 5 chance ke sach null hypothesis ko radd kar dein (isay Type I error kehte hain). Kam α, jaise 0.01, test ko zyada sakht banata hai (7.3).

blocks.prompt:
iv. Draft a clear Null Hypothesis (H₀) and Alternative Hypothesis (Hₐ) for an experiment testing whether rolling a standard 6-sided die is fair or biased.
(6 rukh wale aam paanse (die) ke fair ya biased hone ke test ke liye saaf H₀ aur Hₐ likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
H₀: Paansa fair hai; har rukh (1 se 6) ka chance barabar, 1/6, hai.
Hₐ: Paansa biased hai; kam az kam aik rukh ka chance 1/6 se mukhtalif hai.
Test: paansa phenkein (maslan 60 dafa, har rukh ke 10 mutawaqqa) aur dekhe gaye (observed) ko mutawaqqa (expected) se chi-square test se milayein, jaise kitab ki misal mein (7.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki misal mein 60 dafa phenkne par 10, 12, 8, 14, 9, 7 aaye aur chi-square = 3.4 bana. Is value ko table ki critical value se milate hain: chhoti ho to H₀ (fair) radd nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
v. Why is the p-value important in hypothesis testing?
(Hypothesis testing mein p-value kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: p-value H₀ ke khilaf saboot ki taaqat batati hai: agar H₀ sach ho to dekhe gaye (ya is se bhi zyada) nataij aane ka imkaan (probability). Isay α se milate hain: p < α (jaise 0.03 < 0.05) ho to H₀ radd, warna nahi. Yun saaf, data par mabni faisla hota hai aur baghair saboot radd ya qubool karne ki ghalti nahi hoti (7.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka jumla: "p chhoti, H₀ radd". Kitab ki misal: naya parhane ka tareeqa, p = 0.03 < 0.05, to H₀ (koi asar nahi) radd, yani tareeqe ne marks behtar kiye.

blocks.prompt:
vi. How Artificial Intelligence is useful in our daily lives? Give two examples.
(AI hamari rozmarra zindagi mein kaise mufeed hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
AI computer science ki shaakh hai jo machines ko insani zehanat wale kaam (seekhna, patterns pehchanna, faisla) karne deti hai.
Rozana istemal: voice assistants (Siri, Alexa), websites ke chatbots, chehra/tasweer pehchanna, YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon ki recommendations.

blocks.prompt:
vii. How does blockchain ensure security and transparency in transactions?
(Blockchain len-den mein hifazat aur transparency kaise yaqeeni banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain records ko ek markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par rakhta hai. Har tasdeeq shuda block pichle se jura hota hai aur na badalne wali chain banti hai; har computer ke paas copy hoti hai, is liye chupke se data badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai. Bank jaise darmiyani (intermediary) ke baghair sab record check kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
viii. How does e-waste impact the environment?
(E-waste mahol par kaise asar dalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: E-waste tab banta hai jab electronic devices phenk diye ya badal diye jayen. Ghalat tareeqe se thikane lagane se mahol aur insani sehat ko nuqsan aur aaloodgi (pollution) hoti hai, aur purane devices ke wasail (resources) zaya hote hain. Recycling, dobara istemal, kam devices aur kam bijli wale devices (sustainable computing) yeh nuqsan kam karte hain (9.5).

blocks.prompt:
Q. 5: What is OSI model? Explain its layers and their functions? (08)
(OSI model kya hai? Is ki layers aur un ke kaam samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) network communication samajhne ka standard model hai. Yeh communication ko saat layers mein baant deta hai; har layer ka khaas kaam hai aur data step by step in layers se guzarta hai. Layers ki wajah se network samajhna, banana aur ghalti dhoondna (troubleshooting) aasan hota hai, aur aik layer mein tabdeeli doosri par asar nahi karti.

Saat layers (sender ki taraf upar se neeche):
7. Application layer: users aur applications ko seedhi services deti hai; HTTP, FTP aur email jaise protocols.
6. Presentation layer: data ko application ke samajhne wali shakal mein badalti hai; encryption, compression aur format conversion.
5. Session layer: applications ke darmiyan session shuru, qaim aur khatam karti hai; rukawat ke baad checkpoints aur recovery.
4. Transport layer: data ki bharosemand (reliable) aur tarteeb wali delivery; error recovery, flow control aur data ko segments mein todna.
3. Network layer: data ko source se destination tak networks ke paar route karti hai; IP addressing aur behtareen rasta.
2. Data Link layer: seedhe jure nodes ke darmiyan bina ghalti transfer; framing, error detection/correction aur shared medium ka access.
1. Physical layer: kacha (raw) data electrical, optical ya radio signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai; cables, connectors, voltage aur data rate tay karti hai.

Neeche wali layers physical transfer, darmiyani routing aur delivery, aur upar wali user applications sambhalti hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Layers yaad karne ka aasan jumla (neeche se upar): "Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away" = Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. Sender par data upar se neeche jata hai, receiver par neeche se upar.

blocks.prompt:
Q. 6: Write a Python program to demonstrate multilevel inheritance using Grandfather, Father, and Son. (08)
(Grandfather, Father aur Son le kar multilevel inheritance dikhane wala Python program likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Multilevel inheritance tab hoti hai jab aik class aisi class se inherit kare jo khud kisi aur se derived ho, yani khandan ke shajre (family tree) jaisi chain: Grandparent → Parent → Child. Sab se neeche wali class (pota) ko apne parent aur grandparent dono ke attributes aur methods milte hain (3.2, Figure 3.5). Yahan Father, Grandfather se inherit karta hai, aur Son, Father se.

Program:
# Grandparent (base) class
class Grandfather:
    def __init__(self, surname):
        self.surname = surname

    def show_land(self):
        print(f"Grandfather {self.surname} owns farmland.")


# Parent class: inherits from Grandfather
class Father(Grandfather):
    def show_business(self):
        print(f"Father {self.surname} runs a shop.")


# Child class: inherits from Father (and so from Grandfather)
class Son(Father):
    def __init__(self, name, surname):
        super().__init__(surname)      # calls Grandfather's __init__
        self.name = name

    def show_skill(self):
        print(f"Son {self.name} {self.surname} writes Python programs.")


s = Son("Ali", "Khan")
s.show_land()        # inherited from Grandfather
s.show_business()    # inherited from Father
s.show_skill()       # defined in Son
print(isinstance(s, Grandfather))

Output:
Grandfather Khan owns farmland.
Father Khan runs a shop.
Son Ali Khan writes Python programs.
True

Wazahat:
- Grandfather base (dada) class hai; is ka __init__ surname rakhta hai aur show_land() is ka method hai.
- class Father(Grandfather): Father darmiyani (parent) class hai; show_land() wirse mein leti hai aur show_business() barhati hai.
- class Son(Father): Son derived (child) class hai; name aur show_skill() barhati hai.
- super().__init__(surname) parent ka constructor chalata hai (jo Father ko Grandfather se mila), is liye surname set hota hai.
- Son ka object s Grandfather ka show_land(), Father ka show_business() aur apna show_skill() chalata hai; pehle do Son mein dobara nahi likhe gaye.
- isinstance(s, Grandfather) True hai: Son ka object Father bhi hai aur Grandfather bhi.

Faida: upar ki classes mein aik dafa likha code neeche ki classes dobara use karti hain; takrar (repetition) kam hoti hai aur program barhana aasan hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asal zindagi ki misal: dada ki zameen, abbu ki dukaan aur bete ka hunar. Beta zameen aur dukaan dono istemal kar sakta hai, chahe woh khud ne nahi banayin; isi tarah s.show_land() aur s.show_business() Son mein likhe baghair chalte hain. Kitab ki apni misal Vehicle → Car → ElectricCar hai; exam mein sawal ke naam (Grandfather, Father, Son) hi use karein.

blocks.prompt:
Q. 7: Describe model evaluation techniques and explain accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score. (08)
(Model evaluation ke tareeqe bayan karein aur accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Model evaluation ka matlab hai check karna ke model kitna achha kaam karta hai, us test data par jo training mein use nahi hua. Is se model ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan pata chalti hain. Performance metrics woh pemaane hain jin se yeh napa jata hai.

Istilahat: TP = sahi pehchane gaye positive, TN = sahi pehchane gaye negative, FP = ghalti se positive kahe gaye, FN = ghalti se negative kahe gaye.

1. Accuracy: kul predictions mein se kitni sahi (percentage). Error rate is ka ulat. Sirf accuracy kabhi dhoka deti hai, khaas kar unbalanced data mein.
Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)

2. Precision: jin ko positive kaha un mein se kitne waqai positive; durusti (correctness) par tawajjuh. Zyada precision = kam ghalat alarm.
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)

3. Recall: asal positive cases mein se kitne pakre gaye; mukammal-pan (completeness) par tawajjuh. Zyada recall = kam chhoote hue cases.
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)

4. F1-score: precision aur recall ka tawazun (balance) ek number mein; unbalanced data mein mufeed. Zyada = behtar.
F1 = 2 × (Precision × Recall) / (Precision + Recall)

Misal (kitab ki values TP = 40, TN = 50, FP = 10, FN = 5):
Accuracy = (40 + 50) / 105 = 0.857 (85.7%)
Precision = 40 / 50 = 0.8
Recall = 40 / 45 = 0.8889
F1 = 2 × (0.8 × 0.8889) / (0.8 + 0.8889) = 0.8421

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Spam filter ki misal: precision poochti hai "jo emails spam kahin, un mein se kitni waqai spam thin?" (ghalat alarm kam). Recall poochti hai "tamam asal spam emails mein se kitni pakri gayin?" (koi spam na chhoote). F1-score in dono ka darmiyani number hai. Hisaab: 40 + 50 = 90 sahi, kul 105, to accuracy 90/105 = 0.857.

blocks.prompt:
Q. 8: Discuss the benefits and challenges of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in society. How can ethical principles ensure fair and responsible use of AI? (08)
(Muashre mein AI ke fawaid aur challenges bataiye. Akhlaqi usool AI ka munsifana aur zimmedarana istemal kaise yaqeeni banate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
AI kaam ko tez, durust aur aasan banati hai, magar is ke khatre bhi hain jinhein sambhalna zaroori hai.

Munsifana aur zimmedarana AI ke akhlaqi usool:
- Fairness (insaf): imtiyazi sulook na ho; admission system gender, ilaqe, zaban ya pas-manzar par student ko tarjeeh ya radd na kare.
- Accountability (jawabdehi): ghalat faisle ka koi zimmedar ho.
- Transparency (shaffafiyat): batana ke system ne faisla kaise kiya, jaise student kyun select ya reject hua.
- Safety (hifazat): diagnosis system achhi tarah test ho taake nuqsan-deh nateeja na de.
- Bias se bachao aur inclusivity: developers training data (jaise zyada mardon wala hiring data, ek rang ke chehron wala data) check aur durust karein taake AI sab ki barabar khidmat kare.
- Privacy aur qanooni frameworks: ijazat se data aur GDPR aur AI ethics guidelines jaise qawaid.
Yeh usool AI ko insani faide ka aala rakhte aur ghair-irada nuqsan se bachate hain.

rows: Dohrane wale kaam insanon se tez
Automation se naukriyan khatam hona
Doctors ki tashkhees mein madad (3D scans se aankh ki bimari)
Zaati data ki privacy ka khatra
Kisanon ki fasal ki nigrani
Algorithm ka bias na-munsifana nataij deta hai
Chatbots hazaron customers ko ek saath jawab; business trends ka andaza
Zindagi par asar wale faislon mein akhlaqi masail
Taleem mein har student ke mutabiq parhai
Automation par had se zyada inhisar

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bias ki misal: agar hiring AI sirf purane record se seekhe jahan zyada mard select hue, to woh aurat ke achhe CV ko bhi kam number dega. Is liye data check karna (bias hatana), faisle ki wajah batana (transparency) aur ghalti ka zimmedar tay karna (accountability) zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q. 9: Describe how privacy and security settings on online platforms can be managed. Explain why reading privacy policies is important for data protection? (08)
(Bataiye ke online platforms par privacy aur security settings kaise sambhali ja sakti hain. Samjhaiye ke data protection ke liye privacy policies parhna kyun zaroori hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Privacy aur security settings users ko control deti hain ke un ki zaati maloomat kaise use aur share ho. Yeh aksar apps, websites aur platforms mein hoti hain.

Settings sambhalna:
- Kaun posts dekhe aur kaun rabta kare (Instagram account private, sirf manzoor shuda followers posts dekhein).
- Location sharing band aur app permissions mehdood (location, contacts, browsing history).
- Izafi hifazat ke liye 2FA on.
- WhatsApp par profile photo kaun dekhe, aur read receipts (blue ticks) band.
- Settings baqaidagi se check aur update, kyunke platforms qawaid badalte rehte hain.
Is se ghair-mutaliqa log ya advertisers maloomat ka ghalat istemal nahi karte aur user ko apni digital maujoodgi par control milta hai.

Privacy policy parhna:
Privacy policy batati hai ke data kaise jama, use, store aur share hota hai.
- Kaunsa data liya jata hai (naam, email, location, browsing, app ka istemal) aur kis maqsad se.
- Kya data advertisers ya third-party services ko diya jata hai.
- Account banane ya terms manne se pehle parhne se user faisla kar sakta hai ke data de ya nahi.
- Zaati maloomat be-ijazat share nahi hoti; data par control user ke paas rehta hai.
